For the fourth consecutive year, Vizient Inc. ranked NYU Langone No. 1 for quality care in the nation and U.S. News & World Report recently placed 12 of its clinical specialties among the top 10 in the nation. For more information, go to NYU Langone Health , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X , YouTube and Instagram . Position Summary We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Sr. Network Cloud Engineer. The Senior Network Cloud Engineer is a senior technical member of the Network Engineering team responsible for the architecture, implementation, optimization, automation, and operational support of enterprise network infrastructure across on-premises data centers and multi-cloud environments. This role serves as the technical lead for cloud networking initiatives spanning AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while also providing deep expertise in enterprise LAN, WAN, Internet edge, DNS, routing, and network security integration. The ideal candidate possesses advanced engineering experience designing highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures supporting critical business applications. The engineer will partner closely with Infrastructure Security, Cloud Architects, Infrastructure Services, and Application teams to deliver reliable enterprise networking services. Job Responsibilities Multi-Cloud Network Design Design, implement, and support enterprise network architectures within AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Develop resilient cloud connectivity using: AWS Direct Connect Azure ExpressRoute Google Cloud Interconnect Site-to-Site VPN Design hybrid cloud networking between enterprise data centers and cloud providers. Design cloud segmentation strategies supporting production, development, disaster recovery, and isolated recovery environments. Design secure cloud landing zones and shared network services. Develop cloud network standards, templates, and reference architectures. Enterprise Network Engineering Design and support large-scale enterprise WAN, LAN, and Data Center networks. Engineer redundant Internet edge connectivity. Support SD-WAN and traditional Carrier Ethernet environments. Develop enterprise network resiliency and disaster recovery strategies. Cloud Connectivity Design secure connectivity between cloud providers and enterprise networks. Engineer Transit Gateway architectures. Design virtual WAN environments. Develop hub-and-spoke cloud network topologies. Support multi-region cloud deployments. Optimize cloud routing and traffic engineering. Network Security Integration Collaborate with Infrastructure Security on: Firewall architectures Network segmentation Zero Trust initiatives Secure cloud connectivity IPSec VPN design Private connectivity services Participate in firewall migration and consolidation projects. Design secure routing between cloud and on-premises environments. Network Automation Develop infrastructure automation using: Python Terraform Ansible REST APIs Automate network provisioning and cloud infrastructure deployment. Lead complex troubleshooting efforts. Participate in change management. Develop operational procedures and technical documentation. Mentor junior network engineers. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Experience supporting large enterprise environments with mission-critical infrastructure Preferred Qualifications Preferred Qualifications Experience with Aviatrix multi-cloud networking platform. Experience designing and supporting multi-cloud transit architectures using Aviatrix. Experience with Cisco ACI, VMware NSX, or other software-defined networking technologies. Experience with Infoblox DDI solutions. Experience supporting healthcare, financial services, or other highly regulated enterprise environments. Familiarity with network observability and monitoring platforms such as ThousandEyes, NetBrain, or similar tools. Preferred Certifications AWS Certified Advanced Networking Specialty Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) Enterprise Infrastructure or CCNP Enterprise HashiCorp Terraform Associate Infoblox Certified Professional (ICP) (preferred) Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization. Lead the retirement of VMware and Citrix Hypervisor (XenServer), moving workloads to Proxmox or the cloud. Support Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365 and Windows servers alongside the wider IT team. Keep systems hardened and patched, own infrastructure vulnerability remediation, and run regular backup and restore tests. Handle tier 3 incidents and take part in an on-call rotation. Within 90 days you handle routine hardware and Linux work independently. Within 12 months you own datacenter operations and infrastructure as code, VMware and Xen are well on their way out, and restore tests run on a schedule. This role is based in Calgary with regular on-site datacenter time and an after-hours on-call rotation. Qualifications 5+ years in systems or infrastructure engineering across Linux and Windows. Required Skills Hands-on datacenter hardware experience. Strong Linux administration and scripting (PowerShell plus Bash or Python). Practical Terraform and Git experience, including public cloud. Packer image builds and production virtualization experience (VMware, Xen or Proxmox), including migrating VMs between platforms. A practical grounding in security hardening: least privilege, MFA, patching and logging. Preferred Skills HPC scheduler experience (Slurm, PBS) and scale-out storage. Azure DevOps pipelines, Ansible, Intune or NinjaOne. Security or cloud certifications (Security+, AZ-104, Terraform Associate, RHCSA).

Job Description Who You’ll Work With We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst to join our dynamic, remote cybersecurity team. The ideal candidate is a critical thinker, self-starter, and driven professional with hands-on experience using Crowdstrike or other EDRs. You will play a critical role in monitoring, triaging, and responding to cyber threats across our primarily Mac and Linux environments, with some Windows systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of fellow SOC analysts, incident responders, threat hunters, and cross-functional partners across IT, engineering, and DevOps to ensure our security posture remains strong. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, excels in high-pressure settings, and is skilled in writing CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL) (or similar) to create effective detections that protect our organization’s assets. What You’ll Do Monitor and triage security alerts. Build, test, and refine detections to enhance threat identification across Mac, Linux, and Windows systems. Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents, including malware, phishing, and advanced persistent threats, leveraging SIEM and EDR capabilities. Perform proactive threat hunting using the SIEM and EDR features. Investigate and respond to incidents swiftly, following established incident response protocols. Document findings clearly and provide actionable remediation recommendations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen security controls and mitigate vulnerabilities. Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends through self-directed learning. Participate in on-call rotation for 24x7x365 SOC coverage, demonstrating reliability and accountability. Escalate confirmed or suspicious incidents and cases to the Incident Response team. Qualifications 4-5+ years in a SOC and or active participant on incident response teams. Hands-on experience with CrowdStrike (or other EDR), triaging security incidents. Proven ability to write CQL (or similar) queries and build detections for threat monitoring. Experience triaging alerts in a high-volume environment. Experience with threat intelligence feeds, platform and OSINT tools (VirusTotal, etc.) Familiarity with forensic analysis and evidence handling. Skills And Attributes Exceptional critical thinking and analytical skills to address complex security challenges. Self-starter with a proven ability to take initiative and deliver results independently. Driven mindset, thriving in fast-paced, high-pressure remote work environments. Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat landscapes, and attack vectors. Proficiency in analyzing logs, network traffic, and endpoint data using CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM, particularly for Mac and Linux systems (Windows experience a plus). Solid knowledge of incident response processes and methodologies. Familiarity with operating systems, with primary expertise in Mac and Linux, and secondary knowledge of Windows. High attention to detail and ability to make sound decisions under pressure. Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development in cybersecurity. Nice-to-Have Write and optimize detections to detect and investigate security events. Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python) for automating SOC workflows. Experience creating playbooks in Crowdstrike Fusion SOAR (or similar SOAR) Knowledge of cloud security (GCP, AWS, and or Azure). Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Additional Information Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big-hearted, tech-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®. We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement. Senior Network Engineer THE OPPORTUNITY Reliable, secure networks don’t happen by accident. They’re built by engineers who understand the architecture, anticipate risk, and know where to look when something isn’t working. As a Senior Network Engineer at Quantum Health, you’ll help design, secure, and evolve the network infrastructure behind an organization that millions of members depend on. You’ll work hands-on with Arista EOS, spine-leaf architecture, Arista CloudVision, Palo Alto firewalls, Strata Cloud Manager, routing, VPNs, and cloud connectivity while leading complex projects and serving as an escalation point when the toughest problems show up. You’ll also help set technical standards, mentor other engineers, strengthen automation, and continuously improve the reliability, security, and visibility of our network. If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems and building networks that are secure, resilient, and ready to scale, we’d love to meet you. WHERE YOU’LL WORK Work remotely anywhere in the United States or hybrid from our Dublin, Ohio campus. What You’ll Make Happen Build for reliability. Design, configure, and support enterprise switching environments using Arista EOS and spine-leaf architecture. Own the network fabric. Support MLAG, VLANs, VRFs, segmentation, high availability, and routing across complex data center environments. Put CloudVision to work. Use Arista CloudVision for configuration management, compliance, upgrades, telemetry, provisioning, and change validation. Strengthen network security. Configure and optimize Palo Alto firewalls, including security policies, NAT, App-ID, User-ID, URL filtering, threat prevention, GlobalProtect, IPsec VPN, and Strata Cloud Manager. Solve the tough problems. Lead troubleshooting across Layer 2/3, BGP, OSPF, VPNs, firewalls, routing, application connectivity, performance issues, and security events. Lead high-impact change. Support segmentation, firewall and data center migrations, circuit turn-ups, hardware refreshes, cloud connectivity, and other network initiatives. Raise the technical bar. Develop standards, diagrams, implementation plans, operational procedures, validation plans, and troubleshooting documentation while mentoring other network engineers. Keep making the network better. Identify opportunities to improve reliability, observability, security, automation, performance, and operational maturity. YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF... You’re the engineer people call when the problem isn’t obvious. You can troubleshoot deeply, think architecturally, communicate clearly, and stay calm when the stakes are high. You Bring A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, ideally including significant enterprise firewall and data center networking responsibility. Strong hands-on experience with Arista EOS and CloudVision, including modern spine-leaf environments. Experience configuring and supporting Palo Alto firewalls and Strata Cloud Manager. Deep understanding of BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, MLAG, NAT, VPNs, segmentation, high availability, and enterprise routing. Experience troubleshooting complex network, application-connectivity, firewall, VPN, routing, and performance issues. Experience planning and executing network changes with clear risk analysis, implementation, validation, and backout procedures. Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to partner across Security, Cloud, Systems, Applications, Service Desk, and external vendors. A high level of accountability and commitment to protecting the sensitive information entrusted to Quantum Health. BONUS POINTS IF... You have experience with VXLAN/EVPN in an Arista environment. You’ve worked with Prisma Access, GlobalProtect, or other cloud-delivered security technologies. You’ve automated network tasks using Python, Ansible, APIs, or CloudVision workflows. You have experience with monitoring and ITSM tools such as Grafana, LibreNMS, PRTG, ServiceNow, or Jira. You hold certifications such as Palo Alto PCNSE/PCNSA, Arista ACE, CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, CCIE, Network+, or Security+. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Compensation: Competitive base pay, incentive plans, and employee referral bonuses. Coverage: Health, vision, and dental, plus life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP resources, TelaDoc services, and more. Retirement: 401(k) with up to a 4% employer match and full vesting from day one. Balance: PTO, seven paid holidays, parental leave, volunteer days, paid sabbaticals, and more. Development: Up to $5,250 annually in tuition reimbursement, certification and continuing education support, paid training, and leadership development. Culture: A people-first environment where technology, collaboration, and innovation help make healthcare work better. READY TO BUILD SOMETHING RELIABLE? Here’s what you can expect from our hiring process: Application → Assessment (if needed) → Interviews → Offer → Background Check → Start Your Career! We value different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. review_candidates.title: (Hybrid) Network Engineer II - Network Segmentation
review_candidates.description: Job Requirements Join Our Team as a Network Engineer II – Network Segmentation! Spartanburg Regional Healthcare System is looking for a talented Network Engineer II – Network Segmentation to support our Healthcare IT team in designing, implementing, and managing network segmentation strategies across our hospital enterprise. If you are passionate about network security, eager to grow your expertise, and ready to collaborate with a dynamic team, this is the opportunity for you! Why Join Us? At Spartanburg Regional Healthcare System, we are dedicated to leveraging advanced technology to enhance patient care and security. As a Network Engineer II , you will collaborate closely with senior engineers and IT teams to strengthen our network defenses while gaining hands-on experience with cutting-edge security technologies. What You Will Do: Network Segmentation & Security: Assist senior engineers in developing and implementing network and application segmentation strategies aligned with security best practices and compliance requirements. Support the design and configuration of VLANs, subnets, and access control lists (ACLs) to enforce segmentation policies. Help implement micro-segmentation solutions to protect critical assets, applications, and sensitive data. Work with the firewall team to optimize rules and policies, ensuring effective security enforcement. Infrastructure & Risk Management: Utilize knowledge of TCP/IP, IOS, multiple routing protocols, wireless protocols (LWAPP), VPN, perimeter security, and Layer 3 content switching to support segmentation initiatives. Monitor network traffic for potential security breaches and suspicious activity. Assist in conducting security audits and vulnerability assessments to identify and mitigate segmentation gaps. Access Control & Collaboration: Help manage and enforce access controls within network and application segments, ensuring adherence to the principle of least privilege. Work closely with Network Infrastructure, Server Services, Firewall Team, and IT Security to support segmentation requirements and security objectives. Maintain comprehensive documentation of network segmentation designs, configurations, and procedures. What You Bring to the Team: Minimum Requirements: Education: High School Diploma. Experience: Minimum 3 years of network engineering experience. Certifications: CCNA required. Preferred Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, or a related field. Experience: 5-7 years of IT experience, preferably in a healthcare or enterprise environment. Certifications: CCNP preferred. What Sets You Apart? Experience with VoIP and legacy telephony systems. Knowledge of firewall rule optimization and security compliance frameworks. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with a proactive approach to network security and risk mitigation. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and support security best practices. Ready to Grow Your Career? If you are an experienced Network Engineer looking to advance your skills and contribute to a mission-driven healthcare IT environment, we would love to hear from you! Apply today and be part of a team that is shaping the future of healthcare IT at Spartanburg Regional Healthcare System.

review_candidates.description: W firmie Aristocrat dążymy nieustannie do doskonałości i innowacji. Nasza kultura sprzyja współpracy i integracji, zapewniając, że wkład każdego członka zespołu napędza nasz sukces. Poszukujemy doświadczonego i proaktywnego Inżyniera Sieci, który dołączy do naszego zespołu ITOps - Global Network Infrastructure. Ta rola jest kluczowa dla naszej misji, ponieważ będziesz odpowiedzialny/-a za rozwój, wdrożenie i optymalizację naszej przedsiębiorczej infrastruktury sieciowej. Jeśli szukasz możliwości pracy z nowoczesną technologią i chcesz być częścią światowej klasy zespołu, to idealna rola dla Ciebie! Zakres obowiązków Projektowanie, wdrażanie i utrzymywanie bezpiecznych i skalowalnych rozwiązań sieciowych w środowiskach LAN/WAN. Zarządzanie projektami związanymi z firewallami Palo Alto Networks, obejmującymi rozwój polityki, zapobieganie zagrożeniom i konfigurację VPN. Zarządzanie i optymalizacja infrastruktury bezprzewodowej i przełączania Aruba, w tym ClearPass i AirWave. Monitorowanie wydajności sieci i rozwiązywanie skomplikowanych problemów przy użyciu zaawansowanych narzędzi diagnostycznych. Implementacja i egzekwowanie wytycznych dotyczących bezpieczeństwa sieci oraz standardów zgodności. Współpraca z zespołami funkcjonalnymi w celu wsparcia projektów infrastrukturalnych i aplikacji biznesowych. Mentoring młodszych inżynierów i zapewnienie technicznego przywództwa w zespole. Prowadzenie szczegółowej dokumentacji konfiguracji sieci, diagramów i procedur operacyjnych. Udział w rotacji dyżurów i wsparcie działań związanych z reakcją na incydenty. Budowa i wsparcie rozwiązań opartych na ciemnych włóknach dla infrastruktury sieciowej o dużej przepustowości. Wymagania Tytuł licencjata w dziedzinie Informatyki, Technologii Informacyjnej lub pokrewnej (lub równoważne doświadczenie). Minimum 5 lat praktycznego doświadczenia w inżynierii sieci przedsiębiorstw. Znajomość pracy z firewallami Palo Alto Networks i rozwiązaniami sieciowymi Aruba. Dobre zrozumienie TCP/IP, protokołów routingu (OSPF, BGP), VLANów i subnettingu. Doświadczenie w pracy z narzędziami do monitorowania i analizy sieci (np. Wireshark, SolarWinds, PRTG). Umiejętność budowania i wdrażania bezpiecznych architektur sieciowych. Doskonałe umiejętności analityczne, komunikacyjne i dokumentacyjne. Preferowane certyfikaty takie jak PCNSE, CCNP lub równoważne. Doświadczenie w automatyzacji sieci i skryptowaniu (Python, Ansible) będzie dodatkowym atutem. Znajomość sieci chmurowych (AWS, Azure) i środowisk hybrydowych jest pożądana.
